name: Wasp
identity: Original golden ochre hovering wasp, very large rounded head, two long dark segmented antennae, round gold-brown eye plates, a small tapered black-brown and gold striped abdomen with its original tiny dangling gold claws, two cream veined wings represented by raised/lowered postures.

anatomy_observations.source_wing_nodes: WingUpL/R and WingDownL/R are two alternating poses of the SAME left/right wings, not four wings.
anatomy_observations.claws: Small gold claws integrated in the source abdomen; keep integrated in the new Body slice. No six-leg walking rig.
anatomy_observations.heads: Original receiver has Angry=0 and Dead=1. Preserve original events; new directional views provide Normal/Angry/Dead. Up head states all share one faceless rear shell.
anatomy_observations.flight: Suspended original altitude; no ground shadow. Ready/Walk alternate source wing visibility at 12 Hz, Attack includes original Event(Attack) at 0.333333343 s; all native clips 0.5 s.
anatomy_observations.connections: Wing roots share one attachment and common sprite canvas in both postures; head and abdomen overlap at opaque collar, wings render behind torso.
